name: skill-usage
description: Live view of which skills load, why they load, and whether GOATED hook nudges and holds are followed

registryPath.title: GOATED registry path
registryPath.description: The installed GOATED registry, goated-stack.yaml, when it is not in ~/.claude/goated/stack/ or beside the mod in a GOATED checkout. Empty looks in those two places.

usageLogPath.title: GOATED usage log path
usageLogPath.description: The GOATED core's usage log, when GOATED_USAGE_LOG puts it elsewhere than the core's per-user default. Sessions other adapters logged there add to All time. Empty looks in the default.
